en: Fixed vim mode: `dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` and their `c`/`y` forms acting on part of a line; `1G` going to the last line; `d0`/`c0`/`y0` doing nothing; the cursor being off by one after `.` repeats an insert; and `o`/`p` on a `!`-prefixed line switching to shell mode
zh: 修复 vim 模式：`dj`/`dk`/`dG`/`dgg` 及其 `c`/`y` 形式只作用于行的一部分；`1G` 跳到末行；`d0`/`c0`/`y0` 无效果；`.` 重复插入后光标偏移一位；以及在以 `!` 开头的行上按 `o`/`p` 切换到 shell 模式
